title: Component Manifest v1
description: Schema for Generative UI Component manifest.json files

description.description: Short description of what the component does

component_type.description: action = LLM-invoked via tool call, structural = data-driven, system = platform infrastructure

category.description: UI category for filtering. Must match the categories used by components and component_registry.json; 'General' is the canonical fallback for an uncategorised component (the loader default in manager.py).

agent_pack_id.description: If installed via agent pack, the pack ID

instances.description: Whose the things this component keeps are — every component declares it: 'user' — the user's own (listed whichever agent is in use), 'agent' — the active agent's own (its graph, memory, sources, actions, products, concepts), 'page' — held in the open page only, not kept, 'none' — it keeps nothing (stateless). The component card's pill and the Workspace's scoping both read this one field.

acts_every_turn.description: Acts on EVERY turn without being called (the Context Window Manager assembles every prompt, Memory recalls into every prompt, the Needs Input raisers watch every turn). The resource vocabulary's 'active' — a declaration of the component's nature, never a switch: active is always a subset of enabled.

tool_definition.description: Tool definition for action components (injected into LLM context)

file.description: Filename of the instructions file (relative to component dir)

format.description: plain = raw text, intensity_keyed = JSON keyed by intensity level

placeholder_substitutions.description: Map of {PLACEHOLDER} → filename for text substitution

handler_file.description: Python handler filename (relative to component dir)

fast_path.description: If true, executor can skip tactical LLM for this component

renderer_file.description: JS renderer filename (relative to component dir)

cdn_dependencies.description: CDN libraries to load before rendering

profile_defaults.description: Default profile settings for this component

enabled_for.description: Profile types where this component is enabled by default

default_intensity.description: Default intensity level for this component

on_for_new_agents.description: CREATION default only: whether a NEW agent's editor starts with this component switched on. Absent = on when enabled_for lists any type. Never a resolution step: an existing agent resolves through enabled_for exactly as before (components/enablement.py).

signals.description: How this component talks to others — ONE declaration read by the page bus gate, the component card and the Workspace. `emits`/`listens`: page events (uderia:* names registered in static/js/uderiaBus.js) its renderer raises / reacts to. `announces`: the write actions its store announces on the per-user channel as `component_changed` (core/ui_notify.announce_component_change) — created · updated · deleted · restored · refreshed · …; empty for a component that keeps nothing. `consumes_refs`: it takes `source_ref` (an earlier result's ref from the session ledger) — true, or {implicit: 'latest_data'} to read the latest data result when no ref and no content is given. `conflicts_with`: components the profile editor will not enable together with this one. Contract: src/trusted_data_agent/components/signals.py.

roles.description: A component whose agent-facing tool is scoped by ROLES (today only Platform): what an agent holding the component is FOR. 'grant' — where an agent's chosen roles are stored (componentConfig.<component_id>.roles; a capability, so signed); 'default' — the roles an agent that names none holds; 'definitions' — the folder of role files, relative to the component (one JSON file per role); 'playbooks' — the progressive skill whose playbooks the roles slice. Roles only ever narrow what the component offers; they carry no user tier.
